Josh Gates and his team dive into the ocean depths in search of extraterrestrial life beneath the waves. Investigating unexplained lights and mysterious objects hidden in the abyss, they explore some of the planet's deepest alien mysteries.

About Expedition X:
Explorer Josh Gates has put together a team to undertake investigations delving into realms beyond the "unknown." Jessica Chobot and Phil Torres join his quest to mount unprecedented expeditions into the unexplained and perhaps unexplainable.
